Menene jirgin yakin Bismarck?
Context:Bismarck shi ne na farko na biyu Bismarck-aji battleships gina domin Nazi Jamus ta Kriegsmarine. An kira shi bayan Chancellor Otto von Bismarck, an kafa jirgin a tashar jirgin ruwa na Blohm & Voss a Hamburg a watan Yulin 1936 kuma an kaddamar da shi a watan Fabrairun 1939. An kammala aikin a watan Agustan 1940, lokacin da aka ba shi izini a cikin rundunar jiragen ruwa na Jamus. Bismarck da 'yar'uwarta jirgi Tirpitz sune manyan jiragen ruwa da Jamus ta gina, kuma biyu daga cikin manyan jiragen ruwa da aka gina ta kowane ikon Turai.  A cikin aikin watanni takwas na jirgin ruwa, Bismarck ya gudanar da wani aiki ne kawai wanda ya ɗauki kwanaki 8 a watan Mayu 1941, mai suna Rheinübung. Jirgin, tare da jirgin ruwa mai nauyi Prinz Eugen, ya shiga cikin Tekun Atlantika kuma ya kai hari kan jiragen ruwa na Allied daga Arewacin Amurka zuwa Burtaniya. An gano jiragen ruwa guda biyu sau da yawa daga Scandinavia, kuma an tura rundunonin sojan ruwa na Birtaniya don toshe hanyarsu. A yakin Denmark Strait, jirgin ruwa mai suna HMS Hood ya fara shiga Prinz Eugen, mai yiwuwa ta hanyar kuskure, yayin da HMS Prince of Wales ya shiga Bismarck. A cikin yaƙin da ya biyo baya, Bismarck da Prinz Eugen sun haɗu da Hood, wanda ya lalata Prince of Wales kuma ya tilasta ta koma baya. Bismarck ya sha wahala sosai daga hare-haren uku da Yarima na Wales ya yi don tilasta kawo karshen aikin.  Rushewar Hood ya haifar da bin bindigar da Royal Navy ta yi ba tare da yin amfani da jiragen ruwa ba. Kwana biyu bayan haka, zuwa Faransa da aka mamaye don yin gyare-gyare, Bismarck ya kai farmaki da 'yan bindiga goma sha biyar na Fairey Swordfish daga jirgin saman jirgin sama na HMS Ark Royal; daya ya zira kwallaye wanda ya sa kayan aiki na jirgin ya zama ba zai iya aiki ba. A cikin yakin karshe a safiya mai zuwa, Bismarck da aka yi wa rauni ya shiga cikin yakin basasa biyu na Birtaniya da kuma manyan jiragen ruwa biyu, kuma sun ci gaba da lalacewa da kuma asarar rayuka. An nutsar da jirgin don hana shi shiga cikin Birtaniya, kuma don ba da damar barin jirgin don rage ƙarin asarar rayuka. Yawancin masana sun yarda cewa lalacewar yaƙin zai sa ta nutse a ƙarshe.  Robert Ballard ne ya gano jirgin a watan Yunin 1989, kuma tun daga wannan lokacin wasu masu bincike da yawa sun bincika shi.

Menene amfanin rarraba aiki?
Context:Rarraba aiki shine rabuwa da ayyuka a cikin kowane tsarin tattalin arziki ko ƙungiya don mahalarta su iya ƙwarewa (ƙwarewa). Mutane, ƙungiyoyi, da al'ummomi suna da ƙwarewa na musamman, kuma ko dai suna haɗuwa ko cinikayya don amfani da damar wasu ban da nasu. Kwarewar musamman na iya haɗawa da kayan aiki ko albarkatun ƙasa da ƙwarewa. Horarwa da haɗuwa da kayan aiki da sauran kadarorin da ke aiki tare galibi suna da mahimmanci. Alal misali, mutum zai iya ƙwarewa ta hanyar samun kayan aiki da ƙwarewa don amfani da su yadda ya kamata kamar yadda ƙungiya za ta iya ƙwarewa ta hanyar samun kayan aiki na musamman da hayar ko horar da masu aiki masu ƙwarewa. Rarraba aiki shine dalilin kasuwanci da kuma tushen dogaro da tattalin arziki.  A tarihi, haɓaka rarraba aiki yana haɗuwa da haɓakar yawan samarwa da cinikayya, haɓakar jari hujja, da haɓaka rikitarwa na ayyukan masana'antu. An lura da ra'ayi da aiwatar da rarraba aiki a cikin tsohuwar al'adun Sumerian (Mesopotamian), inda aka sanya ayyukan a wasu biranen tare da karuwar cinikayya da dogaro da tattalin arziki. Rarraba aikin aiki gabaɗaya yana haɓaka haɓaka mai samarwa da ma'aikacin mutum.  Bayan juyin juya halin Neolithic, kiwo da noma sun haifar da wadataccen abinci mai yawa, wanda ya kara yawan jama'a kuma ya haifar da kwarewa na aiki, ciki har da sababbin nau'o'in masu sana'a, mayaƙan, da kuma ci gaba da fitattu. Wannan ƙwarewar ta ci gaba ta hanyar tsarin masana'antu, da masana'antun juyin juya halin masana'antu. Dangane da haka, yawancin masana tattalin arziki na gargajiya da kuma wasu injiniyoyin injiniyoyi, kamar Charles Babbage, sun kasance masu ba da shawara ga rarraba aiki. Hakanan, sanya ma'aikata suyi aiki ɗaya ko iyakantaccen aiki ya kawar da dogon lokacin horo da ake buƙata don horar da masu sana'a, waɗanda aka maye gurbinsu da ma'aikata marasa ƙwarewa waɗanda aka biya ƙasa da ƙasa amma sun fi samarwa.

Cire sassan gasa na duniya na triathlon a cikin tsari, kuma bayyana kowane sashe.
Context:Duk da yake takamaiman dokoki don triathlon na iya bambanta dangane da hukumar gudanarwa (misali Triathlon na Duniya, Triathlon na Amurka), da kuma don wurin tseren mutum, akwai wasu ƙa'idodi na duniya. A al'adance, triathlon wasa ne na mutum kuma kowane ɗan wasa yana gasa da hanya da agogo don mafi kyawun lokaci. Saboda haka, ba a ba 'yan wasa damar karɓar taimako daga kowa a waje da tseren ba, ban da masu ba da agaji da aka ba da izinin tsere waɗanda ke rarraba abinci da ruwa a kan hanya.   Yankin wucewa (kekuna) na Hamburg Triathlon, 2002 An tsara lokutan Triathlons a cikin sassa biyar masu jere:  daga farkon yin iyo zuwa farkon sauyawa na farko (lokacin yin iyo); daga farkon farkon miƙa mulki zuwa ƙarshen farkon miƙa mulki (lokacin T1); daga farkon hawan keke zuwa ƙarshen ɓangaren hawan keke (lokacin hawan keke); daga farkon sauyi na biyu zuwa ƙarshen sauyi na biyu (lokacin T2); a ƙarshe daga farkon gudu zuwa ƙarshen gudu, a wane lokaci ne triathlon ya cika. Sakamakon yawanci ana sanya su a shafukan yanar gizo na hukuma kuma za su nuna wa kowane ɗan wasan triathlete lokacin yin iyo; lokacin sake zagayowar (tare da sauye-sauye); gudu lokaci; da jimlar lokaci. Wasu tsere kuma suna sanya lokutan sauyawa daban.  Sauran ka'idojin triathlon sun bambanta daga tsere zuwa tsere kuma gabaɗaya sun haɗa da kwatancin kayan aikin da aka yarda (alal misali, an ba da izinin rigar rigar rigakafi a cikin abubuwan da suka faru na USAT a matakin iyo na wasu tsere lokacin da zafin ruwan ya kasance ƙasa da 25.6 ° C (78.1 ° F)), da kuma haramcin tsangwama tsakanin 'yan wasa. Bugu da ƙari, yin amfani da flippers ko wasu ruwa propulsion da kuma flotation taimako ne ba bisa doka ba a triathlon kuma zai iya haifar da disqualification.  Wata doka da ta shafi ƙafafun keke ita ce, dole ne a sanya kwalkwali na ɗan takara kafin ɗan takarar ya hau (ko ma ya mallaki, a wasu yankuna) keke, kuma dole ne ya kasance har sai ɗan takarar ya sauka; ba za a iya buƙatar ɗan takarar ya sa kwalkwali lokacin da ba a kan keke ba (misali yayin gyara matsalar inji). Rashin bin wannan doka zai haifar da rashin cancanta. Bugu da kari, yayin da suke kan hanyar kekuna, duk kekuna za a tura su ne kawai da karfin mutum da karfin mutum. Ban da tura keke, duk wani aiki na motsa jiki da aka kawo ta amfani da hannaye an haramta. Ya kamata injin keken mai gasa ya lalace za su iya ci gaba da tseren muddin suna yin hakan tare da keken su a cikin ja. Hakanan akwai tsauraran dokoki game da layin 'bike mount'. Masu fafatawa ba za su iya fara hawan keke daga sauyawa ba har sai sun wuce layin da aka nuna a fili. Hawan keke kafin wannan na iya haifar da hukunci (misali: an yanke hukuncin kisa na 15 na biyu a gasar Olympics ta London 2012 a kan Jonathan Brownlee, mai gasa daga Burtaniya, don hawan keke da wuri).  Sauran hukunce-hukuncen lokaci na iya faruwa yayin tseren don, a tsakanin sauran abubuwa, zane a kan keke a tseren da ba a tsara ba, wucewa ba daidai ba, zubar da shara a kan hanya, da kuma halin rashin wasa.

Context:Ministan Abinci, Aikin Gona da Kifi na Denmark (Danish: Ministan Fødevarer, Landbrug og Fiskeri) shi ne shugaban da aka nada a siyasa na Ma'aikatar Abinci, Aikin Gona da Kifi na Danish, kuma memba na majalisar ministoci. Hari Seldon, masanin lissafi kuma masanin ilimin halayyar dan adam, ya bunkasa psychohistory, wani sabon fannin kimiyya da ilimin halayyar dan adam wanda ke kula da dukkan yiwuwar a cikin manyan al'ummomi ta hanyar lissafi, yana ba da damar hasashen yiwuwar abubuwan da zasu faru a nan gaba.  Ta hanyar ilimin halayyar dan adam, Seldon ya gano faduwar da kuma faduwar Daular, wanda ya fusata da 'yan majalisa na Hukumar Tsaro ta Jama'a, masu mulki na Empire. Hukumar ta yi la'akari da ra'ayoyin Seldon da maganganun cin amana, kuma an kama shi tare da matashin masanin lissafi Gaal Dornick, wanda ya isa Trantor don shiga kungiyar Seldon. Hukumar ta yi wa Seldon shari'a; yana kare imaninsa, yana bayanin ka'idodinsa da hasashen sa, gami da imaninsa cewa Daular za ta rushe cikin shekaru 300 kuma yayin da Daular ta biyu za ta tashi daga ƙarshe zai zo ne kawai bayan shekaru 30,000 na duhu. Ya sanar da Hukumar cewa za a iya samun madadin wannan makomar kuma ya bayyana musu cewa ƙirƙirar taƙaitaccen ilimin ɗan adam, Encyclopedia Galactica, bazai hana faɗuwar Daular ba amma zai rage zamanin duhu zuwa shekara dubu.  Hukumar masu shakku, ba sa son sanya Seldon shahidi, sun ba shi gudun hijira zuwa wata duniya mai nisa, Terminus, tare da wasu waɗanda za su iya taimaka masa ƙirƙirar Encyclopedia. Ya yarda da tayin su, ya shirya don tashiwar "Encyclopedists" kuma ya sami umarnin sarki wanda ya yarda da ayyukansa. Seldon ya sanar da Dornick cewa, duk da imanin Daular cewa ta ci nasara ta hanyar fitar da Seldon, sakamakon shine ainihin abin da ya yi niyya da fata. Terminus zai zama gida na farko Foundation yayin da na biyu za a kafa "a Star ta End". Seldon sai ya bayyana cewa yana mutuwa, kuma ya roƙi Dornick ya zama jagora a cikin sabon Gidauniyar.

Cire sunayen masu tasiri a kan waƙoƙin Ruben Dario
Context:Wakokin Faransanci sun kasance tasiri mai mahimmanci a cikin Darío a matsayin mawaki. Da farko dai, Romantics, musamman Victor Hugo. Daga baya, kuma a cikin hanyar yanke hukunci, Darío ya sami rinjayar parnassians: Théophile Gautier, Catulle Mendès, da José María de Heredia. Wani tasiri mai muhimmanci shi ne marubucin waka da waka da kuma gwarzon ƙasar Cuba, Jose Martí. Abu na ƙarshe da ke bayyana yanayin Dariyan shine sha'awarsa ga masu alamomin, musamman Paul Verlaine. A cikin sashin "Palabras Liminares" na Prosas Profanas (1896) ya riga ya rubuta sakin layi wanda ya bayyana mahimmancin al'adun Faransa a cikin ci gaban aikin adabinsa:  Tsohon ɗan Spaniard mai farin gemu ya nuna jerin fitattun hotuna: "Wannan -ya ce- shine babban Miguel de Cervantes Saavedra, gwanin hannu ɗaya; wannan shi ne Lope de Vega, wannan shi ne Garcilaso, wannan shi ne Quintana. " Ina roƙonsa don mutum mai daraja Gracián, don Teresa na Ávila, don jarumi Góngora kuma mafi ƙarfi duka, Francisco de Quevedo y Villegas. Sai na ce: "Shakespeare! Dante! (Yadda ake yin waƙa) Hugo...! (kuma a cikin kaina: Verlaine...!) " Sa'an nan, a lokacin da ya ce ban kwana: "-Old mutum, yana da muhimmanci a ce: matata ne daga ƙasata; ta mistress ne daga Paris. "  Los raros littafi ne mai nunawa game da dandano na adabi, wanda ya buga a shekara guda da Prosas profanas, kuma ya sadaukar da shi don yin taƙaitaccen bayani game da wasu marubutan da masu ilimi waɗanda ya ji daɗin sha'awarsu. Daga cikin waɗanda ke cikin littafin mun sami Edgar Allan Poe, Villiers de l'Isle Adam, Léon Bloy, Paul Verlaine, Lautréamont, Eugénio de Castro da José Martí (wanda aka ambata shi kaɗai wanda ya rubuta aikin adabi a cikin Mutanen Espanya). Girman al'adun Faransa ya fi bayyane. Darío ya rubuta: "Halin zamani ba kome ba ne face waƙoƙi na Sfanisanci da waƙoƙi da aka gwada da na Faransanci da kuma na Faransanci". Da yake barin matakin farko, kafin Azul..., wanda waƙarsa ta ba da yawa ga manyan sunayen waƙoƙin Sifen na ƙarni na 19, kamar Núñez de Arce da Campoamor, Darío babban mai sha'awar Bécquer ne. Jigogi na Mutanen Espanya suna da wakilci a cikin aikinsa, tuni a cikin Prosas profanas kuma, musamman, bayan tafiyarsa ta biyu zuwa Spain, a cikin 1899. Sanin lalacewar Mutanen Espanya na zamani a cikin siyasa da zane-zane (damuwar da ya raba tare da abin da ake kira Generation of '98), sau da yawa ya yi wahayi zuwa ga haruffa da abubuwan da suka gabata. Context:Laser na'ura ce da ke fitar da haske ta hanyar aiwatar da fadada gani wanda ya danganci fitowar fitowar hasken lantarki. Kalmar laser wani abu ne wanda ya samo asali ne a matsayin acronym don fadada haske ta hanyar motsawar radiation. An gina laser na farko a 1960 da Theodore Maiman a Hughes Research Laboratories, bisa ga aikin da Charles H. Townes da Arthur Leonard Schawlow suka yi.  Laser ya bambanta da sauran tushen haske a yadda yake fitar da haske da ke da daidaito. Haɗin sararin samaniya yana ba da damar mayar da hankali ga laser zuwa wani wuri mai mahimmanci, yana ba da damar aikace-aikace kamar yankan laser da lithography. Haɗin sararin samaniya kuma yana ba da damar hasken laser ya kasance mai ƙanƙanta a kan manyan nesa (collimation), yana ba da damar aikace-aikace kamar alamun laser da lidar (ganewar haske da kewayawa). Lasers kuma na iya samun babban haɗin lokaci, wanda ke ba su damar fitar da haske tare da kunkuntar bakan. A madadin haka, ana iya amfani da daidaiton lokaci don samar da ƙananan ƙarancin haske tare da faɗakarwa mai yawa amma tsawon lokaci kamar femtosecond.  Ana amfani da lasers a cikin na'urorin faifai na gani, firintocin laser, masu binciken barcode, kayan aikin DNA, fiber-optic, da kuma sadarwar sararin samaniya, samar da kwakwalwan kwakwalwa (photolithography), tiyata da laser da kuma maganin fata, yankan da walda kayan aiki, sojoji da na'urorin tilasta yin doka don yin alama da kuma auna nesa da sauri, da kuma a cikin nuni na hasken laser don nishaɗi. An kuma yi amfani da lasers na semiconductor a cikin shuɗi zuwa kusa da UV a madadin diodes masu ba da haske (LEDs) don motsawa fluorescence a matsayin tushen haske mai haske. Wannan yana ba da izinin ƙaramin yanki mai watsawa saboda mafi girman hasken laser kuma yana guje wa faɗuwar da LEDs ke sha wahala; irin waɗannan na'urori an riga an yi amfani da su a wasu fitilun mota.

Dangane da nassi na gaba, bayyana na'urar farko mai ƙarfi da amfani da ita.
Context:Tun da daɗewa kafin a san wutar lantarki, mutane sun san cewa kifi mai amfani da wutar lantarki zai iya ba da wutar lantarki. Rubutun tsohuwar Masar da aka rubuta daga 2750 KZ sun ambaci wadannan kifaye a matsayin "Thunderer of the Nile", kuma sun bayyana su a matsayin "masu kare" na sauran kifaye. Kifi na lantarki ya sake ba da rahoto bayan dubban shekaru daga tsoffin Girkawa, Roman da Larabawa masu ilimin halitta da likitoci. Marubutan zamanin dā da yawa, kamar su Pliny the Elder da Scribonius Largus, sun ba da tabbaci game da raunin wutar lantarki da ake samu daga kifin kifi da kuma hasken wutar lantarki, kuma sun san cewa irin wannan raunin zai iya wucewa a kan abubuwa masu ɗauke da wutar lantarki. An umurci marasa lafiya da cututtuka irin su gout ko ciwon kai su taɓa kifin lantarki a cikin begen cewa girgizawar mai ƙarfi za ta iya warkar da su. Al'adun d ̄ a da ke kewaye da Bahar Rum sun san cewa wasu abubuwa, irin su sanduna na amber, za a iya shafawa da gashin cat don jawo hankalin abubuwa masu haske kamar gashin tsuntsaye. Thales na Miletus ya yi jerin abubuwan lura game da wutar lantarki a kusa da 600 KZ, daga abin da ya yi imanin cewa friction ya ba da amber magnetic, sabanin ma'adanai kamar magnetite, wanda ba ya buƙatar rubbing. Thales ba daidai ba ne a gaskanta cewa janyo hankalin ya kasance saboda tasirin magnetic, amma daga baya kimiyya za ta tabbatar da haɗin tsakanin magnetism da wutar lantarki. Dangane da wata ka'ida mai rikitarwa, Parthians na iya samun ilimin electroplating, bisa ga binciken 1936 na Batirin Bagadaza, wanda yayi kama da tantanin galvanic, kodayake ba a san ko kayan aikin na lantarki ne a yanayi ba. Wutar lantarki za ta kasance kaɗan fiye da son sani na ilimi na dubban shekaru har zuwa 1600, lokacin da masanin kimiyya na Ingila William Gilbert ya rubuta De Magnete, wanda a ciki ya yi nazari mai kyau game da wutar lantarki da magnetism, ya bambanta tasirin lodestone daga wutar lantarki da aka samar ta hanyar shafa amber. Ya kirkiro kalmar New Latin electricus ("na amber" ko "kamar amber", elektron, kalmar Helenanci don "amber") don komawa ga dukiyar jawo hankalin ƙananan abubuwa bayan an shafe su. Wannan haɗin ya haifar da kalmomin Ingilishi "wutar lantarki" da "wutar lantarki", wanda ya fara bayyana a cikin littafin Thomas Browne's Pseudodoxia Epidemica na 1646. Otto von Guericke, Robert Boyle, Stephen Gray da C. F. du Fay sun gudanar da ƙarin aiki a ƙarni na 17 da farkon ƙarni na 18. Daga baya a ƙarni na 18, Benjamin Franklin ya yi bincike mai zurfi a kan wutar lantarki, ya sayar da dukiyarsa don ya tallafa wa aikinsa. A watan Yunin 1752 an san shi da cewa ya haɗa maɓallin ƙarfe a ƙasan igiyar kite mai laushi kuma ya tashi kite a cikin hadari mai barazanar sama. A jerin walƙiya tsalle daga key zuwa baya na hannunsa ya nuna cewa walƙiya ya gaske lantarki a cikin yanayi. Har ila yau, ya bayyana halin da ya dace da jaridar Leyden a matsayin na'urar don adana manyan cajin lantarki a cikin wutar lantarki da ke kunshe da caji mai kyau da mara kyau. A shekara ta 1775, Hugh Williamson ya ba da rahoton jerin gwaje-gwaje ga Royal Society game da girgizar da ake bayarwa ta hanyar wutan lantarki; A wannan shekarar ne likitan tiyata kuma masanin ilimin lissafi John Hunter ya bayyana tsarin gabobin lantarki na kifin. A shekara ta 1791, Luigi Galvani ya wallafa abin da ya gano game da kimiyyar lantarki, ya nuna cewa wutar lantarki ita ce hanyar da ƙwayoyin jijiyoyi suke aika saƙo zuwa ga tsokoki. Batirin da Alessandro Volta ya ƙera a shekara ta 1800, wanda aka yi da zinc da kuma jan ƙarfe, ya ba masana kimiyya tushen wutar lantarki da ya fi ƙarfin na'urorin da ake amfani da su a dā. Ganewar electromagnetism, hadin kan abubuwan lantarki da na maganadisu, ya kasance saboda Hans Christian Ørsted da André-Marie Ampère a cikin 1819<unk>1820. Michael Faraday ya ƙirƙiro motar lantarki a shekara ta 1821, kuma Georg Ohm ya bincika tsarin lantarki a lissafi a shekara ta 1827. Wutar lantarki da magnetism (da haske) an haɗa su gaba ɗaya ta James Clerk Maxwell, musamman a cikin "A kan Layin Layin Layi" a cikin 1861 da 1862.  Yayin da farkon karni na 19 ya ga ci gaba mai sauri a kimiyyar lantarki, ƙarshen karni na 19 zai ga ci gaba mafi girma a aikin injiniya. Ta hanyar mutane irin su Alexander Graham Bell, Ottó Bláthy, Thomas Edison, Galileo Ferraris, Oliver Heaviside, Ányos Jedlik, William Thomson, 1st Baron Kelvin, Charles Algernon Parsons, Werner von Siemens, Joseph Swan, Reginald Fessenden, Nikola Tesla da George Westinghouse, wutar lantarki ta juya daga sha'awar kimiyya zuwa kayan aiki mai mahimmanci ga rayuwar zamani. A shekara ta 1887, Heinrich Hertz ya gano cewa zafin lantarki da ake haskakawa da hasken ultraviolet yana haifar da wutar lantarki da sauƙi. A shekara ta 1905, Albert Einstein ya wallafa wata takarda da ta bayyana bayanan gwaji daga tasirin hasken lantarki a matsayin sakamakon hasken haske da ake ɗauka a cikin fakiti masu rarrabewa, masu ba da wutar lantarki. Wannan binciken ya kai ga juyin juya halin ma'auni. An ba Einstein lambar yabo ta Nobel a fannin kimiyyar lissafi a shekara ta 1921 don "gano dokar tasirin wutar lantarki". Hakanan ana amfani da tasirin photoelectric a cikin ƙwayoyin hoto kamar waɗanda za'a iya samu a cikin bangarorin hasken rana. Na'urar farko mai ƙarfi ita ce "mai gano gashin tsuntsu" da aka fara amfani da shi a cikin 1900s a cikin masu karɓar rediyo. Ana sanya waya mai kama da gemu a hankali a cikin hulɗa tare da daskararren lu'ulu'u (kamar lu'ulu'u na germanium) don gano siginar rediyo ta hanyar tasirin mahaɗin lamba. A cikin ɓangaren mai ƙarfi, halin yanzu yana iyakance ga abubuwa masu ƙarfi da mahaɗan da aka ƙera musamman don sauyawa da haɓaka shi. Za'a iya fahimtar kwararar yanzu a cikin nau'i biyu: kamar yadda ake cajin electrons, da kuma yadda ake cajin electron da ake kira ramuka. Shin akwai fim game da Wikipedia
Context:Gaskiya Cikin Lambobi? Komai, Dangane da Wikipedia fim ne na Amurka na shekara ta 2010 wanda ke bincika tarihi da al'adun al'adu na kan layi, encyclopedia mai gyara Wikipedia. Fim ɗin yana la'akari da tambayar ko ya kamata a ɗora wa dukkan mutane ko ƙwararru ne kawai aikin gyara kundin sani.  An ba da tarihin shafin da kuma bayanansa, tare da sharhi daga masu kafa Wikipedia Jimmy Wales da Larry Sanger. Masu sharhi da suka bayyana a cikin fim sun hada da marubucin Howard Zinn, Len Downie na The Washington Post, Bob Schieffer na CBS News, tsohon shugaban Encyclopædia Britannica Robert McHenry da tsohon darektan Hukumar Leken Asiri ta Tsakiya James Woolsey. Fim ɗin ya tattauna abubuwan da suka faru waɗanda suka ba da haske mara kyau a kan Wikipedia, gami da rikice-rikicen Essjay da rikice-rikicen tarihin Wikipedia.  Fim din da aka jinkirta ya fara a Wikimania 2010 a Gdańsk a watan Yulin 2010, kuma an nuna shi a Cibiyar Paley ta Media a Birnin New York a ranar 20 ga Oktoba, 2010. An nuna shi a matsayin wani ɓangare na Savannah Film Festival a ranar 3 ga Nuwamba, 2010, a Savannah College of Art and Design's Trustees Theater. Gaskiya a Lambobi? ya sami karɓar maraba, tare da tsokaci mai kyau daga marubucin Ted Leonsis, a cikin littafin AOL Urlesque, da kuma ɗaukar hoto a bikin Fina-Finan Savannah ta Carlos Serrano na District.

Takaita tarihin NATO
Context:Yarjejeniyar Dunkirk ta sanya hannu ne tsakanin Faransa da Burtaniya a ranar 4 ga Maris, 1947, bayan yakin duniya na biyu da farkon Yakin Cacar Baki, a matsayin Yarjejeniyar kawance da taimakon juna idan har Jamus ko Tarayyar Soviet suka kai hari. A watan Maris na 1948, an fadada wannan kawancen a cikin Yarjejeniyar Brussels don haɗawa da ƙasashen Benelux, suna samar da Kungiyar Yarjejeniyar Brussels, wanda aka fi sani da Western Union. Tattaunawa don haɗin gwiwar soja mafi girma, wanda zai iya haɗawa da Arewacin Amurka, ya fara a wannan watan a Amurka, inda manufofin su na waje a ƙarƙashin Truman Doctrine ya inganta haɗin kai na duniya game da ayyukan da suka gani a matsayin cin zarafin kwaminisanci, kamar juyin mulkin Fabrairu 1948 a Czechoslovakia. Waɗannan tattaunawar sun haifar da sanya hannu kan Yarjejeniyar Arewacin Atlantic a ranar 4 ga Afrilu 1949 daga membobin ƙasashe na Western Union da Amurka, Kanada, Portugal, Italiya, Norway, Denmark, da Iceland. Jami'in diflomasiyyar Kanada Lester B. Pearson shine babban marubucin da kuma tsara yarjejeniyar.  Ɗakin doguwar ɗaki tare da layuka masu yawa na mutane da ke zaune a kowane gefe, da kuma tutar da ke rataye a ƙarshen ƙarshen. Jamus ta Yamma ta shiga NATO a 1955, wanda ya haifar da samuwar abokin hamayyar Warsaw Pact a lokacin Cold War. Yarjejeniyar Arewacin Atlantic ta kasance mai zurfi har sai yakin Koriya ya fara kafa NATO don aiwatar da shi tare da tsarin soja mai hadewa. Wannan ya hada da kafa Babban Ofishin Jakadancin Allied Powers Turai (SHAPE) a 1951, wanda ya karbi yawancin tsarin soja da tsare-tsaren Western Union, ciki har da yarjejeniyar da suka yi game da daidaita kayan aiki da yarjejeniyar da za su kafa dakarun soji na kasashen waje a kasashen Turai. A shekara ta 1952, an kafa mukamin Sakatare Janar na NATO a matsayin babban jami'in farar hula na kungiyar. A wannan shekarar kuma an ga manyan manyan jiragen ruwa na NATO na farko, Exercise Mainbrace da kuma shiga Girka da Turkiyya a cikin kungiyar. Bayan taron na London da Paris, an ba Jamus ta Yamma damar sake yin amfani da makamai, yayin da suka shiga NATO a watan Mayu na 1955, wanda hakan ya kasance, babban mahimmin abu a cikin ƙirƙirar Yarjejeniyar Warsaw da Soviet ta mamaye, wanda ke nuna bangarorin biyu masu adawa na Cold War.  Ginin bangon Berlin a shekarar 1961 ya nuna tsananin tashin hankali na Cold War, lokacin da sojojin Amurka 400,000 ke zaune a Turai. Shakka game da ƙarfin dangantakar tsakanin ƙasashen Turai da Amurka ya ragu kuma ya gudana, tare da shakku game da amincin tsaro na NATO game da yiwuwar mamayewar Soviet - shakku wanda ya haifar da ci gaban 'yancin Faransa na nukiliya da kuma janyewar Faransa daga tsarin soja na NATO a shekarar 1966. A shekara ta 1982, sabuwar dimokiradiyya ta Spain ta shiga wannan kawance.  Juyin Juya Halin 1989 a Turai ya haifar da sake nazarin dabarun manufar NATO, yanayi, ayyuka, da kuma mai da hankali kan nahiyar. A watan Oktoba na 1990, Jamus ta Gabas ta zama wani ɓangare na Tarayyar Jamus da haɗin gwiwa, kuma a watan Nuwamba na 1990, haɗin gwiwar ya sanya hannu kan Yarjejeniyar kan Sojojin Sojoji a Turai (CFE) a Paris tare da Tarayyar Soviet. Ya ba da umarnin rage takamaiman sojoji a duk faɗin nahiyar, wanda ya ci gaba bayan rugujewar Yarjejeniyar Warsaw a watan Fabrairun 1991 da rushewar Tarayyar Soviet a wannan Disamba, wanda ya cire ainihin manyan abokan adawar NATO. Wannan ya fara janyewar kashe kudi da kayan aikin soja a Turai. Yarjejeniyar CFE ta ba wa masu sa hannu damar cire kayan yaƙi na yau da kullun guda 52,000 a cikin shekaru goma sha shida masu zuwa, kuma ta ba da damar kashe kuɗin soja na membobin Turai na NATO ya ragu da kashi 28 cikin ɗari daga 1990 zuwa 2015. A cikin 1990 shugabannin kasashen yamma da dama sun ba Mikhail Gorbachev tabbacin cewa NATO ba za ta kara fadada gabas ba, kamar yadda aka bayyana a cikin bayanan tattaunawa na sirri. Duk da haka, rubutun ƙarshe na Yarjejeniyar kan Ƙarshe na Ƙarshe game da Jamus, wanda aka sanya hannu a baya a wannan shekarar, ba shi da wata magana game da batun fadada gabas.  Sassan bangon biyu masu tsayi na bangon bango a cikin ciyawa na ciyawa a gaban wani ginin da aka gina tare da windows na blue-glass. Rushewar Katangar Berlin a 1989 ya nuna wani juyi a matsayin NATO a Turai, kuma wannan sashin bangon yanzu ana nuna shi a waje da hedkwatar NATO. A cikin 1990s, kungiyar ta fadada ayyukanta zuwa yanayin siyasa da na jin kai wanda ba a damu da NATO ba a baya. A lokacin Rushewar Yugoslavia, kungiyar ta gudanar da ayyukanta na farko na soja a Bosnia daga 1992 zuwa 1995 kuma daga baya Yugoslavia a 1999. Wadannan rikice-rikicen sun haifar da babban sake fasalin soja bayan Yakin Cold. An rage tsarin soja na NATO kuma an sake tsara shi, tare da sabbin runduna kamar Babban Ofishin Kwamandan Sojoji na Turai da aka kafa.  A siyasance, kungiyar ta nemi kyakkyawar alaƙa da sabbin jihohi masu cin gashin kansu na Tsakiya da Gabashin Turai, kuma an kafa majalisun diflomasiyya don haɗin gwiwar yanki tsakanin NATO da maƙwabtanta a wannan lokacin bayan Yakin Cacar Baki, gami da Partnership for Peace da shirin Tattaunawar Bahar Rum a cikin 1994, da Euro-Atlantic Partnership Council a cikin 1997, da NATO-Russia Permanent Joint Council a cikin 1998. A taron kolin Washington na 1999, Hungary, Poland, da Jamhuriyar Czech sun shiga NATO a hukumance, kuma kungiyar ta kuma fitar da sabbin ka'idoji don zama memba tare da "Shirye-shiryen Aikin Membership". Waɗannan tsare-tsaren sun yi mulkin ƙarin ƙarin sabbin membobin ƙungiyar. Zaben shugaban Faransa Nicolas Sarkozy a 2007 ya haifar da babban sauyi na matsayin sojan Faransa, wanda ya kai ga dawowa cikin cikakken memba a ranar 4 ga Afrilu 2009, wanda ya hada da Faransa ta sake komawa Tsarin Kwamandan Sojan NATO, tare da kiyaye abin da ke hana nukiliya mai zaman kanta.  Mataki na 5 na yarjejeniyar Arewacin Atlantic, wanda ke buƙatar ƙasashe membobin su zo don taimakawa kowace ƙasa memba da ke fuskantar harin makamai, an yi amfani da shi a karon farko kuma kawai bayan hare-haren 11 ga Satumba, bayan da aka tura sojoji zuwa Afghanistan a ƙarƙashin jagorancin NATO na ISAF. Kungiyar ta yi aiki da wasu karin ayyuka tun daga wannan lokacin, gami da tura masu horarwa zuwa Iraki, taimakawa a ayyukan yaki da fashin teku, kuma a shekarar 2011 ta aiwatar da yankin da ba a tashi ba a Libya daidai da Kudurin Kwamitin Tsaro na Majalisar Dinkin Duniya na 1973.  Rushewar Crimea ta Rasha ta haifar da mummunar hukunci daga dukkan mambobin NATO, kuma yana daya daga cikin lokutan bakwai da aka yi amfani da Mataki na 4, wanda ke kira ga shawarwari tsakanin membobin NATO. Lokaci na baya sun hada da lokacin yakin Iraki da yakin basasar Siriya. A taron kolin Wales na shekarar 2014, shugabannin kasashe mambobin kungiyar NATO sun yi alkawarin a karon farko da za su kashe akalla kashi biyu cikin dari na yawan amfanin cikin gida a kan tsaro nan da shekarar 2024, wanda a baya ya kasance jagora ne kawai. A taron kolin na Warsaw na 2016, kasashen NATO sun amince da kirkirar NATO Enhanced Forward Presence, wanda ya tura kungiyoyin yaki masu yawa na kasa da kasa a Estonia, Latvia, Lithuania, da Poland. Kafin da kuma lokacin mamayewar Rasha ta Ukraine a shekarar 2022, kasashe da dama na NATO sun aike da sojojin kasa, jiragen ruwa da jiragen yaki don karfafa bangaren gabas na kawancen, kuma kasashe da dama sun sake amfani da Mataki na 4. A watan Maris na 2022, shugabannin NATO sun hadu a Brussels don taron koli na musamman wanda ya hada da shugabannin kungiyar G7 da na Tarayyar Turai. Kasashen mambobin kungiyar NATO sun amince da kafa wasu kungiyoyin yaki guda hudu a Bulgaria, Hungary, Romania, da Slovakia, kuma an kunna bangarorin rundunar NATO a karon farko a tarihin NATO.  Ya zuwa watan Yunin 2022, NATO ta tura sojoji 40,000 tare da tsawon kilomita 2,500 (1,550 mi) a gabashin gabas don hana Rasha zalunci. Fiye da rabin wannan adadi an tura su Bulgaria, Romania, Hungary, Slovakia, da Poland, waɗanda ƙasashe biyar ɗin suka tara dakarun tsohon NATO da yawa na sojoji 259,000. Don haɓaka Sojojin Sama na Bulgaria, Spain ta aika da Eurofighter Typhoons, Netherlands ta aika da jirgin sama na F-35 guda takwas, kuma ƙarin jiragen saman Faransa da Amurka za su zo nan ba da daɗewa ba.  NATO tana jin daɗin goyon bayan jama'a a cikin ƙasashe membobinta.

Bayyana ƙididdigar ƙididdiga a cikin maki 3 ko ƙasa da haka.
Context:Sauƙaƙewa mai yawa (QE) wani mataki ne na manufofin kuɗi inda babban bankin ya sayi adadin da aka ƙayyade na takardun gwamnati ko wasu kadarorin kuɗi don ƙarfafa ayyukan tattalin arziki. Sauƙaƙewa mai yawa shine sabon nau'i na manufofin kuɗi wanda ya zo cikin aikace-aikace mai yawa bayan rikicin kudi na 2007-2008. An yi niyya ne don rage koma bayan tattalin arziki lokacin da hauhawar farashin ya yi ƙasa sosai ko mara kyau, yana sa manufofin kuɗi na yau da kullun ba su da tasiri. Ƙididdigar ƙididdiga (QT) yana da akasin haka, inda don dalilai na manufofin kuɗi, babban bankin ya sayar da wani ɓangare na dukiyarsa na takardun gwamnati ko wasu dukiyar kuɗi.  Daidai da ayyukan bude kasuwar da aka saba amfani da su don aiwatar da manufofin kuɗi, babban bankin yana aiwatar da sassaucin yawa ta hanyar siyan kadarorin kuɗi daga bankunan kasuwanci da sauran cibiyoyin kuɗi, don haka haɓaka farashin waɗannan kadarorin kuɗi da rage ribar su, yayin da a lokaci guda ke ƙara yawan kuɗin kuɗi. Koyaya, sabanin manufofin yau da kullun, sassaucin yawa yawanci ya haɗa da siyan haɗari ko kayan aiki na dogon lokaci (maimakon takardun gwamnati na ɗan gajeren lokaci) na adadin da aka riga aka ƙayyade a cikin babban sikelin, a cikin wani lokacin da aka riga aka yi alkawari.  Bankunan tsakiya yawanci suna amfani da sassaucin yawa lokacin da ƙimar kuɗin da suke so ya kusanci ko ya kai sifili. Very low amfani rates jawo wani liquidity tarko, wani halin da ake ciki inda mutane fi son rike tsabar kudi ko sosai liquid dukiya, ba da low dawo a kan sauran kudi dukiya. Wannan ya sa yana da wahala ga ƙimar riba ta sauka ƙasa da sifili; hukumomin kuɗi na iya amfani da sassaucin yawa don ƙara ƙarfafa tattalin arziƙi maimakon ƙoƙarin ƙara rage ƙimar riba.  Sauƙaƙewa mai yawa na iya taimakawa wajen fitar da tattalin arzikin daga koma bayan tattalin arziki da kuma taimakawa wajen tabbatar da cewa hauhawar farashin kaya ba ta sauka ƙasa da burin hauhawar farashin kaya na babban bankin ba. Koyaya, shirye-shiryen QE suma ana sukar su saboda tasirin su da haɗarin su, wanda ya haɗa da manufofin da suka fi tasiri fiye da yadda aka yi niyya don magance deflation (wanda ke haifar da hauhawar hauhawar farashin kaya a cikin dogon lokaci), ko kuma ba su da tasiri sosai idan bankunan sun kasance masu jinkirin bayar da rance kuma masu yiwuwar masu karɓar bashi ba sa son karɓar rance. Hakanan an soki sassaucin yawa saboda haɓaka farashin kadarorin kuɗi, yana ba da gudummawa ga rashin daidaito. Wasu manyan bankunan tsakiya na duniya sun aiwatar da sassaucin yawa bayan rikicin kuɗi na duniya na 2007-08, kuma sake amsawa ga cutar COVID-19.

Waɗanne ƙasashe ne Netherlands ke da iyaka da su?
Context:Netherlands (Dutch), ba bisa ƙa'ida ba Holland, ƙasa ce da ke arewa maso yammacin Turai tare da ƙasashen waje a cikin Caribbean. Ita ce mafi girma daga cikin ƙasashe huɗu na Masarautar Netherlands. Amsterdam ita ce birni mafi yawan jama'a a ƙasar kuma babban birni ne. Hague yana da wurin zama na States General, Cabinet da Kotun Koli. Tashar jiragen ruwa ta Rotterdam ita ce tashar jiragen ruwa mafi yawan aiki a Turai. Schiphol shine filin jirgin sama mafi yawan aiki a Netherlands, kuma na uku mafi yawan aiki a Turai. Netherlands a zahiri yana nufin "ƙasashen ƙasa" dangane da ƙarancin tsawo da shimfidar wuri, tare da kusan kashi 26% da ke ƙasa da matakin teku. A lokacin Jamhuriyar, wanda ya fara a 1588, Netherlands ta shiga wani lokaci na musamman na siyasa, tattalin arziki, da al'adu, wanda ya kasance daga cikin mafi iko da tasiri a Turai da duniya; wannan lokacin an san shi da Golden Age na Dutch. A wannan lokacin, kamfanonin kasuwancinsa, Kamfanin Dutch East India da Kamfanin Dutch West India, sun kafa yankuna da wuraren kasuwanci a duk faɗin duniya.   Tare da yawan mutane miliyan 17.8, duk suna zaune a cikin yanki na 41,850 km2 (16,160 sq mi) <unk> wanda yankin ƙasar yake 33,500 km2 (12,900 sq mi) <unk>Netherlands ita ce ƙasa ta 16 mafi yawan jama'a a duniya kuma ƙasa ta biyu mafi yawan jama'a a cikin Tarayyar Turai, tare da yawan mutane 531 a kowace murabba'in kilomita (1,380 mutane / sq mi). Duk da haka, ita ce ta biyu mafi girma a duniya wajen fitar da abinci da kayayyakin gona bisa ga darajarsu, domin ƙasa mai ni'ima, yanayi mai daɗi, noma mai yawa, da kuma iyawa. Menene tasirin tsire-tsire na cikin gida?
Context:Shuke-shuke na cikin gida ba su da tasiri mai mahimmanci a kan maida hankali kan abubuwan da ke tattare da kwayoyin halitta (VOCs) a cikin yanayin gida na yau da kullun: zai buƙaci tsakanin 10 da 1000 shuke-shuke na cikin gida a kowace murabba'in mita don cimma matakin cire VOC kamar yadda yake faruwa daga musayar aiki tsakanin iska na cikin gida da waje.  Tunanin cewa tsire-tsire masu tsire-tsire suna da tasiri mai mahimmanci akan ingancin iska na cikin gida ya dogara ne akan Nazarin Tsabtace iska wanda NASA ta gudanar a cikin 1980s. Binciken ya gwada tsire-tsire a cikin ɗakunan da aka rufe kuma tare da matakan da ke cikin kwayoyin halitta (musamman benzene, trichloroethylene da formaldehyde). Ya kammala da cewa gwargwadon yadda tsire-tsire na cikin gida ke inganta ingancin iska, tsarin aikin shine ƙananan ƙwayoyin cuta a cikin ƙasa mai kwalliya, maimakon tsire-tsire kansu.  Shuke-shuke na cikin gida suna da tasirin ƙididdiga mai mahimmanci akan maida hankali na carbon monoxide da carbon dioxide a cikin yanayin cikin gida na yau da kullun, rage matakan carbon dioxide da kashi 10-25% da matakan carbon monoxide har zuwa 90%. Tasirin NASA ya bincika don amfani da shi a cikin jirgin sama.  Shuke-shuke kuma suna ƙara yawan ƙwayoyin cuta a cikin gidaje, yayin da suke rage bambancin fungi. Suna ƙara ɗumi, rage canjin zafin jiki, da rage amo.  Hakanan akwai da'awar fa'idodi da yawa na tunani da na jiki don samun tsire-tsire na cikin gida. Bincike mai mahimmanci game da wallafe-wallafen gwaji ya kammala Nazarin da aka bincika ya nuna cewa tsire-tsire na cikin gida na iya ba da fa'idodi na tunani kamar rage damuwa da haɓaka haƙuri da ciwo. Koyaya, sun kuma nuna mahimmancin bambancin hanyoyin da sakamakon. Saboda haka muna da shakku sosai game da maganganun da aka yi cewa tsire-tsire na cikin gida suna haifar da canje-canje masu amfani a tunanin mutum. Da alama fa'idodi sun dogara da halaye na mahallin da ake haɗuwa da tsirrai na cikin gida da kuma halaye na mutanen da ke haɗuwa da su. "

Context:Dataminr an kafa shi ne a shekara ta 2009 ta hanyar digiri na Jami'ar Yale Ted Bailey, Sam Hendel da Jeff Kinsey. Dataminr ya sami karin haske lokacin da ya ba da gargadi cewa an kashe Osama bin Laden da minti 23 da sauri fiye da manyan kungiyoyin labarai.  A cikin 2014, Datamnr ya shiga haɗin gwiwa tare da CNN da Twitter, wanda ya haifar da Dataminr don Labarai, kayan aiki don "faɗakar da 'yan jarida ga bayanin da ke fitowa a kan Twitter a ainihin lokacin".  A ranar 30 ga Disamba, 2019, Dataminr ya yi iƙirarin gano alamun farko na barkewar cutar COVID-19 a cikin sakonnin kafofin watsa labarun jama'a. Kamfanin ya ci gaba da gano gungu da ke nuna ci gaban gaba a cikin jihohi 14 daban-daban na Amurka. Kwana bakwai bayan haka, dukkanin jihohi 14 sun kamu da cutar coronavirus. Dataminr ya yi haɗin gwiwa tare da Majalisar Dinkin Duniya a watan Mayu na 2019 don ba dubban ma'aikatan Majalisar Dinkin Duniya kayan aikin Dataminr's First Alert don ɓangaren jama'a.  Yarjejeniyar leken asirin kafofin watsa labarun Dataminr ga FBI ta karɓi Zerofox a ƙarshen 2020.  A safiyar ranar 5 ga Janairu, 2021, Dataminr ya gargadi jami'an tsaro na Capitol game da damuwar tattaunawar jama'a ta yanar gizo wanda ba da daɗewa ba zai zama tarzoma ta 6 ga Janairu.  A watan Yulin 2021, Dataminr ya gudanar da ma'amalar M&A ta farko lokacin da ya sayi WatchKeeper, wani dandamali na geovisualization da ke Burtaniya. A cikin sayen, Dataminr ya haɗu da bayanan bayanan geovisualized na WatchKeeper tare da dandalin Pulse don samar da mahallin abubuwan da ke faruwa. Bayan 'yan watanni, a cikin Oktoba 2021, Dataminr ya sayi Krizo, dandamali na amsa rikicin lokaci-lokaci da ke Copenhagen, Denmark.  Kamfanin ya kasance # 5 a kan Forbes AI 50 Jerin a cikin 2019 kuma ya kasance mai cin nasarar lambar yabo ta 2019 AI Breakthrough Award don Mafi Kyawun Maganin AI. A cikin 2020, an sanya sunan Dataminr zuwa Forbes Cloud 100, da Deloitte Technology Fast 500, "Mafi yawan amfani da AI" a 2020 AI & Machine Learning Awards.  A cikin 2020, ƙungiyar AI ta Dataminr ta buga takardu da yawa ciki har da, <unk> Gano abubuwan da ba a kula da su ba a cikin bala'o'i masu yawa, <unk> don Association for the Advancement of Artificial Intelligence quarterly journal; <unk> Rarraba abubuwa da yawa na abubuwan da suka faru a cikin kafofin watsa labarun, <unk> don hangen nesa na kwamfuta da kuma ganewar tsari na 2020; <unk> Rarraba saƙonnin kafofin watsa labarun don Amsar Taimakon Humanitarian a lokacin Crisis, <unk> don AI don kyautata zamantakewa, da <unk> ApposCorpus: Sabon harsuna da yawa, tarin bayanai na yanki da yawa don samar da gaskiya, <unk> don COLING 2020.  A ƙarshen 2021, kamfanin ya ba da sanarwar nadin Cristina Bita a cikin kwamitin gudanarwa kuma a matsayin shugabar kwamitin binciken.

Ganin wannan sakin layi game da Cold War, me ya sa Soviets janye daga yaki a Afghanistan?
Context:Bayan Yaƙin Duniya na II, sassan Gabashin Turai da Tsakiyar Turai, gami da Gabashin Jamus da gabashin Austria sun mamaye Red Army bisa ga taron Potsdam. An kafa gwamnatocin kwaminisanci masu dogaro a cikin jihohin tauraron dan adam na Gabas. Bayan ya zama na biyu a duniya nukiliya iko, Tarayyar Soviet kafa Warsaw Yarjejeniyar kawance, da kuma shiga a cikin wani gwagwarmaya domin duniya mamayar, da aka sani da Cold War, da kishiya Amurka da NATO. Bayan mutuwar Stalin a 1953 da kuma ɗan gajeren lokaci na mulkin gama gari, sabon shugaban Nikita Khrushchev ya yi tir da Stalin kuma ya ƙaddamar da manufar de-Stalinization, yana sakin fursunonin siyasa da yawa daga sansanonin aikin Gulag. Gabaɗaya bautar da manufofin zalunci ya zama sananne daga baya a matsayin Khrushchev Thaw. A lokaci guda, tashin hankali na Cold War ya kai kololuwar lokacin da abokan hamayyar biyu suka yi karo da juna game da girke-girke na Amurka Jupiter a Turkiyya da kuma makamai masu linzami na Soviet a Cuba.  A shekara ta 1957, Tarayyar Soviet ta harba tauraron dan adam na farko a duniya, Sputnik 1, ta haka ne aka soma Zamanin Sararin Samaniya. Jirgin saman Rasha Yuri Gagarin ya zama mutum na farko da ya zagaya duniya, a cikin jirgin Vostok 1 wanda ke da jirgin sama a ranar 12 ga Afrilu 1961. Bayan hambarar da Khrushchev a cikin 1964, wani lokacin mulkin gama gari ya biyo baya, har sai Leonid Brezhnev ya zama jagora. Zamanin 1970s da farkon 1980s daga baya aka sanya shi a matsayin Zamanin Ragewa. Gyaran Kosygin na 1965 ya yi niyyar rage rarraba tattalin arzikin Soviet. A shekarar 1979, bayan juyin juya halin kwaminisanci a Afghanistan, sojojin Soviet sun mamaye kasar, a karshe sun fara yakin Soviet-Afghan. A watan Mayu na 1988, Soviets sun fara janyewa daga Afghanistan, saboda adawa da kasa da kasa, ci gaba da yakin basasa na Soviet, da kuma rashin goyon baya daga 'yan kasar Soviet.  Daga 1985 zuwa gaba, shugaban Soviet na karshe Mikhail Gorbachev, wanda ya nemi aiwatar da gyare-gyare na sassaucin ra'ayi a cikin tsarin Soviet, ya gabatar da manufofin glasnost (buɗewa) da perestroika (sake tsarawa) a ƙoƙarin kawo ƙarshen lokacin koma bayan tattalin arziki da dimokiradiyya ga gwamnati. Wannan, duk da haka, ya haifar da hauhawar ƙungiyoyin kishin ƙasa da masu neman rabuwa a duk faɗin ƙasar. Kafin 1991, tattalin arzikin Soviet shi ne na biyu mafi girma a duniya, amma a cikin shekarunsa na ƙarshe, ya shiga cikin rikici.  A shekara ta 1991, hargitsi na tattalin arziki da na siyasa ya soma ƙaruwa sa'ad da ƙasashen Baltic suka zaɓi su ware kansu daga Tarayyar Soviet. A ranar 17 ga Maris, an gudanar da kuri'ar raba gardama, inda yawancin 'yan ƙasa da suka halarci zaben suka goyi bayan sauya Tarayyar Soviet zuwa sabuwar tarayya. A watan Yunin 1991, Boris Yeltsin ya zama shugaban farko da aka zaba kai tsaye a tarihin Rasha lokacin da aka zabe shi shugaban Rasha SFSR. A watan Agusta 1991, yunkurin juyin mulki da membobin gwamnatin Gorbachev suka yi, wanda aka yi wa Gorbachev da nufin adana Tarayyar Soviet, ya haifar da ƙarshen Jam'iyyar Kwaminis ta Tarayyar Soviet. A ranar 25 ga Disamba, 1991, bayan rushewar Tarayyar Soviet, tare da Rasha ta zamani, wasu jihohi goma sha huɗu na Soviet sun fito.
